title: Magic Ride
essence: Alone on the sidewalk after the breakup, the poet finds a motorcycle he wasn't looking for, rubs his aggressions into its steel and rides. The bike holds frame centre and the world streams past it: neon Atlantis, rows of heads that turn, the city's last towers, then mountains, while the night is replaced by morning one dot at a time. He arrives, chilled and innocent, at a ruined chapel on the shore.
palette_notes: Night is deep violet-black and indigo (ba11d121 skyline, night streets); the city's light is sodium amber and orange haze from the district stills (c8158a76 glowing road edges, 5bd8dc26 neon slashes, 31ca5420 smog skyline). Morning is paper cream with a soft gold sun; the last movement cools to a chilly pale blue. The single accent is the white glint off the steel tank, lit by moon, then its own spark, then sun.

full_text.line: I wasn't looking for a ride, but here you are, blissful and oddly sensitive,
withering a soul purveying both the dark and the light worlds I've known.
So I rub my aggressions into your steel coverings and hop on to amuse myself.
Loneliness is having everything with no one to tell,
being everywhere with no one to love and escape,
wide-eyed and stone but alive and well, wandering with no clear end.
I let the noise block the noise so the way I ride through the streets with the swag and eyes turn,
has twists, improve, yeah, the magic still exists.
All preparations to live and dream in darkness I no longer desire.
The moon settles and the tease of distant stars subsides
and I can see a morning ahead for me.
It looks like a morning I could believe in,
a morning where loss and life aren't so well, ripe with sunlight that's deceptively warm.
The tripping of birds, feeling of nests, spring out of the night that has covered me,
with my own curiosities for a chance at an end, where everything will be okay.
I want to live in this feeling forever, blissful and oddly innocent,
riding in a way you can't help but double-click,
improve, yeah, the magic still exists.

insights: Never move the bike: one fixed camera, everything streams past. It costs strips, not animation.
Two builds of the motorcycle: a solid machine only for the one close shot, a skeleton for the ride.
Put the poet behind the machine at the mount, or the two silhouettes merge.
Head turns are loose head discs nudged sideways, not rotated bodies.
The dawn is a hard ragged edge pulled across the sky, not a fade: in cut-out it is literally one card slid over another.
Keep motion smear tight; wide smear turns the crowd into ghosts.

Atlas: the Halfworld frames (foundry/10-02, 10-03) and the markov frame (sets/d0f46314da339169-1) already stage the poem as a fixed silhouette rider over scrolling block skylines with a sun and moon on cards. That is our grammar; keep the bike centred and still.
Atlas: the route is physical (canopy, commons, underpass, viaduct, pass, shore steps); each district gets one light: neon, blue square, white tunnel mouth, sodium lamp, dawn dither.
Atlas: the moon must be gone by the viaduct (it sets behind the spire there); from the pass onward only the sun card exists.
future: The motorcycle stays parked at the chapel in 11.
The chapel ruin and the cold shore are 11's opening set.
The moon disc closes its run here; the sun disc carries into 11.
Streaming strips for the Atlantis skyline can serve any later travel shot.

atlas.district_language: The album's only travelling poem crosses four districts in one direction, neon to dawn, and the bike never leaves frame centre: the world is a stack of scrolling strips. Shrouded Arcade (04:30): near-black facades, colour only in cut neon strips and their wet-floor doubles, magenta light-streak cards smeared horizontally for speed. Cortex Commons (5 a.m., empty): blue square, the sunken forum's lip still lit from below, a radio dish card turning slowly over nobody. Cenotaph Rail: gothic viaduct arches in grey stone, rusted platform railings, one sodium lamp; dawn and dusk only, no light of its own. The mountain pass: hill silhouettes in three receding greys, a dithered pink-to-blue dawn replacing the night sky dot by dot. Paint the strips flat; code only the speed (strip scroll rates), the streaks and the dawn dither. Never show: other riders' faces, a speedometer, daylight before the pass, the moon after the viaduct.

staging.name: The bike under the street lamp
staging.shot: wide flat side-on of the empty curb: one lamp-post card with a cone of light, the bike in the cone, POET entering from left and stopping; then an insert: the round chrome mirror card with his sunglassed face painted in it, the neon street a smear behind.

staging.name: Mounting the machine
staging.shot: tight inserts, each a single card plate: palm circling on the tank (tank card with scuff layer revealed under the hand), fist on the fender (shake), boot swinging over the seat; then medium side-on, he laughs, the background strips start to move.

staging.name: Loneliness through midnight intersections
staging.shot: rear framing: bike back card centre, empty pillion seat foreground; underpass ceiling lights stream toward camera as dashes; through the flooded underpass the floor is a mirror card and white spray flecks peel off the back wheel; then the empty commons with the forum's lit lip sliding past.

staging.name: Swagger down the avenue
staging.shot: low side-on tracking: bike fixed, one hand off the bar; canopy sky card above, shopfront strip and two rows of head-and-shoulder silhouettes scroll past; each head is a pivot card that turns as he passes (a wave of turns). Magenta streak cards on walls and floor.

staging.name: Out of Atlantis as the moon settles
staging.shot: wide from behind the rider: viaduct arch card frames the road; behind, the spire skyline strip recedes (scales down) while the moon card sinks behind it; the NEW DAWN sign card passes at right; ahead, a pale patch opens low on the sky card.

staging.name: Mountain road at first light
staging.shot: high wide on switchbacks (three hill strips in receding greys), then low side angle on the lean: the bike card rotates 25 degrees into the curve; the nest tree passes, bird cards burst from it; a bystander's flash is a one-frame white card; the road splits into two strips drifting apart, bike between.

heroes.name: The LED Canopy and the booth curb
heroes.in_poem: the start (the bike at the booth's lamp, where 09 ended) and the swagger down the avenue under the moving-colour canopy (10.3).
heroes.build_as_cards: reuse 09's canopy underside card on a looping colour scroll and its palm/shopfront strips, now as horizontal scrolling layers at three speeds; the booth curb is the static first plate of 10.0.

heroes.name: The Underpass Shadow-Pool
heroes.in_poem: the bike runs through ankle-deep water under the market at midnight (10.2), the far-end light growing.
heroes.build_as_cards: tunnel as four nested frame cards (graffiti walls, patched ceiling) receding to a white light card; floor is one glossy mirror card with the frames painted inverted; water line marked at 4/10 of the walls; spray is a coded particle of white flecks off the rear wheel.

heroes.name: The Sunken Forum and the Dish
heroes.in_poem: empty at 5 a.m.: he rides past the stepped oval with its lip still lit and the dish turning over nobody (10.2).
heroes.build_as_cards: forum as an ellipse cut-out with a glowing lip strip and stepped rings painted inside; dish as a single profile card on a plinth that rotates on a pin; square floor a blue card; no people.

heroes.name: The Named Viaduct
heroes.in_poem: the ride out of Atlantis under gothic arches as the moon sets behind the spire (10.4); one beat where the engine idles under an arch and he reads a name.
heroes.build_as_cards: a repeating arch card (stone texture, names cut in a band below the +4 m line) that scrolls past in sequence; rusted railing strip on top; one sodium lamp card on a platform; Glazier's white plates over broken spans, gaps left open.

world_details.detail: the city's lights brighten for one beat when the Tide Engine's gates rise (the hot minute): all neon strips flare as he pulls away
names of the drowned carved in a band just below the 4 m line on every viaduct arch
white ceramic plates with a cyan seam over the broken spans of the viaduct; the gaps left open
lanterns on the shore steps, lit by the Wardens at dusk, still burning when he arrives at dawn
world_details.where: the end of the ride, at the shore

world_details.detail: bus shelters every few hundred metres along the arterials, the commonest thing in the city after puddles: a repeating shelter card in the street strip
the Cyan Line maglev crossing overhead on white pylons, a slow string of warm windows

transitions.how: dissolve on the same curb: the EX's haze card fades, the lamp stays, and the bike is lit by the same cone; no cut.

a ride through four districts (canopy, empty commons and underpass, viaduct, the pass) ending on the shore steps; the bike decelerates into frame, the strips stop scrolling, and the chilly-morning shore of 11 is the last plate held still.
